svg.desc: \begin{gathered} \mathbf z(X)=\left(\mathbf 1_{\{t_j\in X\}}\right)_{j=1}^{|\mathcal T|},\\ \mathbf z(X\cup Y)=\mathbf z(X)\lor\mathbf z(Y),\qquad \mathbf z(X\cap Y)=\mathbf z(X)\land\mathbf z(Y),\\ H_g^{\mathrm L}(p)=\sum_j z_j(T(p))z_j(\mathcal L_g),\qquad H_g^{\mathrm D}(p)=\sum_j z_j(T(p))z_j(\mathcal D_g). \end{gathered}
